product.name: Finlens Automated Accounting Platform
product.description: A cloud-based finance platform that automates bookkeeping, transaction categorization, and financial reporting for startups and finance teams.

product.name: Multi-Account Bridge Integration
product.description: A feature that connects multiple bank accounts and credit cards to Finlens for automatic transaction syncing and bookkeeping updates.

product.name: AI Spend Pattern Insights
product.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes expense and income transactions to provide clarity on spending patterns and financial inflows.

product.name: Financial Metrics Dashboard
product.description: An intuitive dashboard displaying key financial metrics such as runway, burn rate, cash flow, and revenue trends for startups.

product.name: Automated Tax-Ready Reporting
product.description: A service that generates tax-compliant financial reports automatically, supporting bookkeeping and tax filing processes.
